project.name: EnhancedEchest
project.description: Paper/Folia plugin replacing the vanilla ender chest with a database-backed one: a player owns several chests of up to 54 slots, each with its own size, custom name and icon, managed from an in-game dialog.
project.build: Gradle Kotlin DSL, single module, shadowJar is the deliverable
project.platform: Paper API 1.21.11 (api-version 1.21); runs on Paper forks 1.21.11 - 26.2; NOT CraftBukkit

docs.changelog: CHANGELOG.md (end-user tone; use the write-docs skill)
docs.internalRunbooks: local-docs/ (docker DB rig, cross-server two-server rig; not published)

commands.note: Only chest index allocation, temp reclaim, the activity-log pipeline, schema upgrade and the load simulations are covered by tests. Every GUI, dialog, command and storage path is verified by running on a Paper/Folia server.

entrypoints.name: plugin bootstrap
entrypoints.role: PluginBootstrap. Registers the /enderchest, /eclist and /enhancedechest Brigadier trees on LifecycleEvents.COMMANDS, before enable. Also the single place permission node constants live.

entrypoints.name: plugin main / wiring hub
entrypoints.role: Every service is a field constructed by hand here. No DI container, so onEnable/onDisable ordering is load-bearing (see flows.startup / flows.shutdown).

entrypoints.name: chest open
entrypoints.role: Decides WHAT to open for /ec, /eclist, right-click and admin /ee view, then funnels into ChestSessionManager.open.

entrypoints.name: dupe-safety funnel
entrypoints.role: The single closed class that mutates the live-session map. Every open goes through open(); admin mutations chain behind forceCloseAll + runExclusive.

entrypoints.name: storage facade
entrypoints.role: The EnderChestStorage everyone actually sees. Authoritative for every resident owner.

files.role: PluginBootstrap: builds the whole Brigadier command tree (/enderchest, /ec, /eclist, /ee) on LifecycleEvents.COMMANDS, each node gated by .requires(...). Declares the permission node constants.
JavaPlugin. Hand-wired service graph, ordered onEnable/onDisable, reload(). @Getter (Lombok) exposes every service.

packages.name: service
packages.role: Open routing, live sessions, dupe-safety, item-moving operations, the async dispatch boundary. The ONLY layer allowed to put storage calls on the async pool.

files.role: Shared-live-inventory registry + the dupe-safety contract. open() is the sole open funnel; forceCloseAll/runExclusive serialize admin mutations per (owner,index); shutdown() persists every open session (blocks <=30s).
invariants: one shared Inventory per open chest
encode-on-save stays synchronous on the global thread

files.role: GUI-flow layer above the session manager: reconciles permission chests, routes /ec vs the list menu vs a direct open, drives the management dialogs and /ee import.

Bounded, batched audit pipeline. Bukkit-thread side captures occupied slots as immutable strings/numbers once; diffing, rendering, rotation and file I/O run on one dedicated worker. Plain-text OPEN/CLOSE headers + ADD/TAKE totals, optional HAVE contents lines, shulker contents in the detail string.
Item-moving operations: shrink-spill, delete (spill or force), bulk delete, and reclaimTempInto (temp chest -> newly granted chest). Force-closes viewers, then runs exclusively per (owner,index).
/ee transfer: moves NORMAL chests onto another account (a move, never a copy). Row swap is one transaction in EnderChestStorage.transferChests.
Grants/revokes ChestKind.PERM chests from enhancedechest.additional_amount.<count>.slot.<size>; all matching permissions stack, reconcile() diffs target vs held.
The shared daemon pool for all async storage work (thread name EnhancedEchest-db). supply()/run(). Bounded (64 cap), sized per backend, closed last on disable.
Thin async wrapper over EnderChestStorage — pure delegation onto DbExecutor, no session logic. Used by dialog callbacks, admin commands, open routing.
Write-through read cache of per-player settings, bounded by online players (preload on join, evict on quit). Also records the player's username / last_online.
In-memory index of every recorded player name (players.username), loaded once at startup; answers offline tab-completion and name resolution without a DB round-trip.
Tells the owner which chest their temp-chest items were moved into. Hooked on the tail of reclaimTempInto so no call site can forget it.

packages.name: storage
packages.role: The lazy per-owner cache, the SQL backends, the schema, autosave. Storage methods are synchronous — the caller dispatches.

files.role: The synchronous storage contract the whole plugin codes against. Ownership model: a player owns a chest iff a row exists for (player_uuid, chest_index).
Lazy-loading write-back cache and the EnderChestStorage everyone sees. Thin facade holding only the ender-chest domain logic.

The coherence engine: load-on-miss residency protocol, write-back flush, idle eviction, the single lock. withOwner() = residency re-check + operation in one lock hold. Generic — knows only owners and dirty rows.
The pure in-memory row model (enderchests/players rows + dirty tracking + index allocation). NOT thread-safe; only ever touched under OwnerResidencyCache's lock.
The narrow SQL contract the cache needs: loadOwner, bulk flush, findExpired/countChests/findUuidByName/loadAllPlayers, backup, importRows. Deliberately NO per-row write operations.
Picks the SQL dialect from config (sqlite/mysql/mariadb/postgresql).
Async repeating flush() + evictIdle() at database.autosave-interval (default 3m), plus flushQuitterLater (quit write-back +5s).
JDBC StorageBackend shared by all dialects: DDL, per-player reads, batched dirty flush, whole-database queries, verbatim import copy. HikariCP pool, database.ssl modes.
SQLite dialect (WAL, 30s busy timeout, VACUUM INTO backup). Driver is compileOnly — comes from the server classpath, never relocated.
MySQL/MariaDB dialect (shaded+relocated MariaDB driver, ON DUPLICATE KEY upserts).
PostgreSQL dialect (shaded+relocated PG driver + com.ongres, ON CONFLICT upserts).

Versioned forward-only migrator for EXISTING installs (fresh installs land on latest via CREATE TABLE). Also renameLegacyTables (enderchests/players/schema_meta -> echest_*), which runs before CREATE TABLE.

packages.name: gui
packages.role: Dialogs, inventory menus, holders, the icon picker.

files.role: All Paper Dialog API usage, isolated here so a Paper breaking change is a one-file edit. List / per-chest detail / rename dialogs, plus the config editor and import dialogs. Renders eagerly with the viewer's Locale.
Pickable chest icons over the Material registry + rendering a chosen icon as an Adventure sprite object component (minecraft:blocks / minecraft:items atlases). Uses gson from the server classpath.
The shared 'open the documentation' button (book sprite, URL from gui.yml, address never shown on screen).
The simple /eclist inventory chooser (enderchest.list-menu: inventory): one icon per chest, padding-border layout sized 27/36/45/54 to the chest count; >28 chests falls back to the dialog.
Marker InventoryHolder for the chooser menu (read-only: every interaction is cancelled). Carries the source block location and slot -> chest index map.
Marker InventoryHolder on every custom ender chest Inventory: owner, 1-based index, size, ChestKind, optional source block.
Vanilla lid animation + sound via the pure Paper Lidded API (no NMS). Must be called on the block's region thread; degrades to a no-op.

packages.name: command
packages.role: Brigadier command bodies. Registration itself lives in the bootstrap, not plugin.yml.

files.role: /ec (open) and /eclist (management list).

/ee add|resize|delete <player>. Add allocates the next free index and may grant an expiring chest; resize spills cut-off items; delete removes the newest N chests (spill by default, 'force' to hard-delete), never the first chest.
/ee transfer <from> <to> <index|name|all> [override|temp]; the target and flag are parsed from one greedy argument so names may contain spaces.
/ee import — opens the DB->DB import dialog (player-only).
/ee migrate vanilla [all|<player>] — vanilla ender chest -> chest #1.
/ee migrate axvaults [all|<player>].
/ee migrate playervaultsx [all|<player>].
/ee migrate customenderchest [all|<player>].
Name -> UUID for admin commands, works offline. Order: online exact match -> the plugin's own players table -> Paper usercache -> Bukkit offline lookup. Table/offline steps run on the async executor.
/ee reload -> EnhancedEchestPlugin.reload().

packages.name: listener
packages.role: Join/quit lifecycle, click and drag guards, right-click interception.

files.role: Click/drag guards on the custom chest GUI, admin edit permission check, deny sound throttle, and the detach-on-close that triggers the save when the last viewer leaves.
Intercepts right-clicking an ender chest block (and shift+right-click -> chest list when enderchest.shift-click-list is on).
Drives the 27-slot chooser: cancels every click/drag, opens the clicked chest through ChestOpener.openChest.
Join: pin in the storage cache, preload settings (which also materializes the chest rows = the join prefetch). Quit: stamp last_online, evict, unpin, schedule the delayed write-back.
Backstop detach when a player disconnects with the GUI open. detach is idempotent.
Auto-migrates un-migrated players on join when migration mode is on. The isMigrated pre-check runs on DbExecutor, never the join thread.
On-join chat + action bar (+ sound) reminder that items are still sitting in temp chests (temp-enderchest.join-notify).
Loads language files and exposes them as locale-free Component.translatable; parsed Components are cached. Every player-facing string must have a key here in every bundled locale.
The Adventure Translator registered once on GlobalTranslator, so every Component is rendered against the recipient's own client locale. Fallback: exact -> same language -> configured locale -> en_US.

packages.name: config
packages.role: Typed config + YAML migration. Renaming a key without a rule silently loses the setting.

files.role: Typed snapshot of config.yml. Fields read live from other threads are volatile (telemetry metric suppliers may only read from here).
Runs on startup for every config/language file: apply renames, add missing keys from the bundled default, write only if changed. Existing user values are never touched.
The central registry of YamlMigrator.Rename entries. Add one whenever a key is renamed; order matters only for chained renames.

packages.name: migration
packages.role: Importing from vanilla, other vault plugins, or another database.

files.role: Vanilla ender chest -> chest #1. Runs its DB write phase under the session manager's exclusivity, and re-checks the migrated flag inside it, so it can never migrate twice or clobber a live session.
/ee import: copies all data from an old backend into the ACTIVE backend in one transaction. Item bytes are copied verbatim (no de/serialization).
Opens an EnhancedEchest DB of any dialect read-only and reads its rows verbatim for the DB->DB copy.
Connection details for the import source, as filled in by the import dialog.
AxVaults vault #N -> chest #N; never overwrites a chest that already holds data, so it is safe to re-run.
Reads axvaults_data and decodes the AxAPI ITEM_ARRAY framing (int slot count, then per slot an unsigned short length + gzip NBT item bytes).
PlayerVaultsX vault #N -> chest #N, same never-overwrite rule.
Reads plugins/PlayerVaults/newvaults/<uuid>.yml and decodes the Base64 CardboardBoxSerialization framing.
CustomEnderChest gives one chest per player -> imported into chest #1 only, never a different index.
Reads plugins/CustomEnderChest/playerdata/<uuid>.yml (storage.type: yml).

packages.name: crossserver
packages.role: Redis owner locks that make the residency cache safe across several servers on one database.

files.role: The coordination contract: an owner may be resident here only while this server holds their distributed lock. Release is split (beginRelease inside the cache lock, finishRelease after — never network I/O under the lock).
Redis implementation: one TTL'd, heartbeat-extended lock key per owner + a pub/sub channel for fast handover. Never steals a live holder's lock; a crashed holder's key just expires.
Thrown when an owner's lock could not be obtained within the acquire timeout. Propagates like a failed SQL read — the operation fails loudly, never proceeds on stale data.
One chest as loaded for opening: owner, 1-based index, size, customName, containerData bytes, kind, icon, expiry.
Lightweight per-chest description used to build the list dialog and decide what /ec opens.
NORMAL / TEMP / PERM. TEMP is auto-created overflow (always expiring, disappears when emptied); PERM is permission-granted and untouched by admin commands.
Per-player state, one row in players, loaded and saved whole. Adding a setting = record component + DDL column in all three dialects + a SchemaMigrator step.

Thin wrapper over Paper's io.papermc.paper.threadedregions.scheduler API — safe on both Paper and Folia with no platform branching. runAsync/runAtEntity/runAtLocation/runNextTick take a Consumer<ScheduledTask>, the *Later/*Timer* variants have Runnable overloads. isFolia() exists for exactly one genuine behavioural branch.

The stored blob format: [1-byte version tag] + body. 0x02 (current) = ItemStack.serializeItemsAsBytes, which preserves slot positions and migrates across Minecraft versions on read. Isolates the Data Component API.
Thrown on a decode failure.

Async repeating sweep at check-interval: a DB-side candidate query (the only way to see offline owners) re-verified against authoritative memory, plus a scan of resident owners. NORMAL -> spill into a temp chest; TEMP -> hard delete. Reuses the spill service, so expiry is as dupe-safe as a manual delete.

Async repeating snapshot via EnderChestStorage.backup (SQLite VACUUM INTO — consistent while players save). SQLite only; remote backends log a one-time warning and stay idle. Prunes backups/ to the most recent `keep` files.

The ONLY telemetry type the rest of the plugin may depend on. telemetry.error(e, "site-label") always accompanies a log line, never replaces it. NOOP when no token was baked in, so call sites never null-check.

The dev.faststats implementation, resolved via create() -> NOOP on failure. Metric suppliers run on SDK threads: they may only read immutable/volatile PluginConfig fields. Custom metrics are deliberately only storage_type + language.
Modrinth lookup with a GitHub release fallback; points users at the matching download page.
Notifies permitted players on join when an update is available.
Parses/formats durations: s/m/h/d/w/mo/y (month = 30d, year = 365d), simple (20s) or underscore-joined (1d_2h_30m_15s). Also the 'expires in' text.

startup.note: The order is load-bearing — there is no DI container.
steps: config (YamlMigrator first, then PluginConfig), Scheduler, ContainerCodec, IconCatalog.setExternalLangDir
Telemetry — before storage, so every later layer can report errors
the cross-server coordinator when cross-server.enabled (a misconfiguration DISABLES the plugin, never degrades silently)
StorageFactory.create -> wrapped in CachedStorage -> init() (DDL + SchemaMigrator; no bulk load)
LanguageManager, then its translator registered once on Adventure's GlobalTranslator

services bottom-up: DbExecutor -> StorageGateway / PlayerNameIndex / PlayerSettingsCache -> ChestActivityLogger -> ChestSessionManager -> ChestSpillService / ChestTransferService / PermissionChestService / DatabaseImportService -> ChestOpener
migration services, ExpirySweeper, BackupService, AutosaveService
listeners, pin + preload already-online players, update check, bStats, startup banner

shutdown.note: Order matters as much as startup.
steps: detach the translator
stop the timers
sessionManager.shutdown() — persists every open session, blocks <=30s for pending saves
telemetry, settings cache
dbExecutor.shutdown()
storage.close() — the final full flush
Redis
cancel tasks
a listener or command calls ChestOpener
ChestOpener reconciles permission chests and decides WHAT to show
funnels into ChestSessionManager.open — the single dupe-safe funnel
the row is read and decoded on the DB executor
the shared Inventory is built on the global thread; viewers attach to it
on LAST viewer close the contents are encoded (synchronously, global thread) and written into CachedStorage
CachedStorage keeps the rows in memory until an autosave, a quit write-back or the shutdown flush pushes them to SQL
ChestSessionManager.forceCloseAll — flushes and closes every viewer's GUI
ChestSessionManager.runExclusive per (owner,index) — load, decode, mutate, save with no concurrent open observing a half-applied state

invariants.rule: A chest's contents exist in exactly one place at a time: one shared Inventory per open chest, loaded fresh on first open, saved on LAST viewer close, with a pending-save wait on reopen. Every open path funnels through ChestSessionManager.open. The encode on save is synchronous on the global thread.
invariants.breaks: A second, independently loaded Inventory reintroduces duping.

invariants.rule: CachedStorage is authoritative for every resident owner. Per-owner operations go through withOwner (residency re-check + operation in one lock hold), dirty => resident, eviction takes only clean owners. In cross-server mode: resident => this server holds the owner's Redis lock.
Storage methods are synchronous; only com.enhancedechest.service may dispatch them onto the async pool (DbExecutor, thread pool EnhancedEchest-db).
invariants.breaks: Dispatching from elsewhere loses the dupe-safety ordering.

invariants.rule: All scheduling goes through com.enhancedechest.scheduler.Scheduler. Never touch an entity or block off its region thread. Scheduler.isFolia() exists for exactly one behavioural branch (ChestSessionManager's single-viewer-on-Folia vs concurrent-edit-on-Paper rule) — do not add new platform branches.

Player-facing strings are never literals — always a LanguageManager key that exists in every bundled locale. Dialogs and inventory item names must be rendered EAGERLY with the viewer's Locale; only chat and inventory window titles are auto-rendered by Paper.
Commands are registered in EnhancedEchestBootstrap on LifecycleEvents.COMMANDS, not plugin.yml. Each node is gated by .requires(...); admin permissions default to op.
Config keys are renamed through a ConfigMigrations rule. Renaming without one silently loses the setting.
The main chest is never auto-assigned. createChest/ensureChest insert with is_primary = 0 and a delete does not promote a survivor; only the dialog's 'Set as main' sets it.

Telemetry is the only telemetry type the rest of the plugin may depend on; everything dev.faststats stays inside FastStatsTelemetry. Custom metrics are deliberately just storage_type + language — action counters were removed on request, do not reintroduce them without asking.
Compiled against Paper 1.21.11 so the jar runs on 1.21.11 through 26.2 — do not call APIs newer than 1.21.11.

Shaded libs are relocated under com.enhancedechest.libs.* (HikariCP, MariaDB, PostgreSQL + com.ongres, Jedis + commons-pool2 + org.json, bStats, FastStats). The SQLite driver and gson are compileOnly from the server classpath and must NOT be relocated.
